title: Skill Gap Analyzer
description: An AI-powered application that analyzes a user's existing skills against their career goals and surfaces the specific gaps to close, with structured, actionable insights.
highlights: FastAPI backend with endpoints for user input, skill-analysis requests, and structured results
Google Gemini integration for AI-assisted skill-gap insights and personalized recommendations
Clear separation between the interface layer and the analysis logic

title: Intelligent Crop Advisory System
description: A machine-learning-based agricultural advisory system combining crop recommendation, fertilizer recommendation, plant-disease detection, and yield prediction in one unified application.
highlights: Random Forest models for crop and fertilizer recommendation, Random Forest for yield prediction
MobileNetV2 (TensorFlow/Keras) for plant-disease detection from leaf images
Interactive Streamlit interface with Plotly visualizations, deployed via cloudflared tunneling
Built as a group Applied Machine Learning course project with a login/user-history system and a full project report

title: Pokemon Pokedex
description: A responsive, interactive Pokedex website for exploring detailed Pokemon information with simple navigation and an engaging browsing experience.
highlights: JavaScript-powered interactive features for types, abilities, stats, and moves
Structured HTML content combined with dynamic client-side functionality
